items.name: Lamplighter's Wick
items.lore: Nessa's spare lamp-wick. It never lights a path that isn't there.

items.name: Glass Keener's Shard
items.lore: A shard of the Glass Keener, on a cord. It keens very faintly in the wind.

items.name: Sorlaith's Blue Brand
items.lore: An Azure captain's bracer, blue enamel, scorched.

items.name: Cullen Gold Cup Charm
items.lore: A little gold cup from the hoard, three thousand years old.

items.name: Battle-Crow's Feather
items.lore: A black feather, bound in a ring. You hear wings when you fight.
